| Metric | 2025 Q4 | YoY % | 2024 Q4 | YoY % |

- **New Markets:** Entry into financial services (Amazon Pay, credit cards) and healthcare (Amazon Pharmacy).

- **Weaknesses:** Regulatory exposure, competitive pressure, margin compression in e‑commerce.  
- **Opportunities:** AI, global expansion, new services (financial, healthcare).
